svg.title: Supply credentials at runtime
svg.desc: A 1Password vault holds the secret value. A project script reads the named environment variable MODEL_API_KEY without containing the value. op run supplies it to the running process, which authenticates to an approved LLM service account. Research output files do not contain the credential.
svg.text: Supply the key when the command runs
The script contains no key value
The running process uses the key
Project settings can store a reference to the vault item
